updates.content:
Title: Users may be unable to install applications on Windows devices through Microsoft Intune

User impact: Users may have been unable to install applications on Windows devices through Microsoft Intune.

Final status: We've been alerted by our automated monitoring system to an issue in which users in Central US may have been unable to install applications on Windows devices through Microsoft Intune. We've identified that a gateway configuration change caused this impact. We've reverted this configuration change to remediate impact and confirmed with our service health telemetry that this issue has been resolved. 

Scope of impact: Users in Central US who attempted to install applications on Windows devices through Microsoft Intune may have been impacted by this event.

Start time: Wednesday, November 11, 2026, at 8:12 PM UTC

End time: Wednesday, November 11, 2026, at 8:57 PM UTC

Root cause: A gateway configuration change caused this impact.

Next steps: 
- We're investigating the impacting gateway configuration change to better understand what it was intended to do and why impact wasn't caught prior to deployment so that we can prevent impact to installing applications on Windows devices through Microsoft Intune in the future. 

This is the final update for the event.
